product.title: Great Barrier Reef 40 Minute Scenic Flight from Cairns - Reef Hopper

description.text: In Cairns, this 40-minute Reef Hopper flight leaves GSL Aviation on Royal Flying Doctor Street and passes Green Island, Arlington Reef, Upolu Reef, Double Island, and Palm Cove. The published format is a high-wing aerial circuit with guaranteed window seats rather than a full-day snorkel cruise. The format suits visitors who want an overhead reef window without boarding a pontoon. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cairns, and the itinerary stays on those coastal and reef landmarks that define this outing rather than a Mossman Gorge walk.

start.description: Meet at GSL Aviation, 83 Royal Flying Doctor St, Cairns City QLD 4870, or request the published central Cairns pickup.

end.description: Return to the Cairns meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
